## About
BDM Performance Exhaust is a custom exhaust shop at 504 Knox Ct in Denver. We do it all from mild to wild, whether you want to trick out your custom ride, let your big diesel breathe, or just get your vehicle back in good repair.
We love cars and trucks, and we really love cool cars and trucks. Exhaust is our specialty, but our technicians are more than capable of handling most repairs and maintenance. Most of our customers are repeat or referred customers, and local street and rod shops send their work our way too.
Drivers have given us a 4.7 rating on Google from 463 reviews. Give us a call or stop by, and let us take care of you.

## Services
- Custom exhaust: Aftermarket mufflers and cat-back systems that replace a restrictive factory exhaust, so the engine can exhale a little easier. Built for custom rides, trucks and big diesels.
- Gas mileage enhancement: Almost every new vehicle comes with a restrictive factory exhaust built to be quiet and inexpensive. A less restrictive system lets the engine work more efficiently.
- Brake inspection and repair: Stop by and we will take a look at your brakes to make sure you and your passengers are safe on the road.
- Routine maintenance: Keep your car running its best on a regular service schedule. Come down and we will help you get started.

## FAQ
Q: Do you only work on exhaust?
A: Exhaust is our specialty, but our technicians can handle most repairs and maintenance, including brakes.

Q: Can I bring in mufflers I already bought?
A: One reviewer bought Gibson mufflers and had us install them, welded in properly instead of clamped.

Q: When are you open?
A: Tuesday through Saturday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM. We are closed Sunday and Monday.
